definitions.explanation: Wearing thin or few layers of clothing. The opposite of 厚着 (dressing warmly in heavy layers). Can refer to both the state of wearing light clothes and the act of dressing lightly.

examples.japanese: {薄着|うすぎ}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{出|で}かけたら→出かける：00833_dekakeru⟧⟦{風邪|かぜ}→風邪：02188_kaze⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{引|ひ}いた→引く：01978_hiku⟧。
examples.english: I caught a cold because I went out in light clothing.

examples.japanese: {子|こ}ども⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{薄着|うすぎ}⟦させないで→する：00392_suru⟧⟦ね→ね：09474_ne⟧。
examples.english: Don't let the child go out lightly dressed, okay?

examples.japanese: ⟦{春|はる}→春：00627_haru⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦なる→なる：01970_naru⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧{薄着|うすぎ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{人|ひと}→人：00476_hito⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{増|ふ}えて→増える：01183_fueru⟧、⟦{街|まち}→街：17306_machi⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{雰囲気|ふんいき}→雰囲気：03604_funiki⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{明|あか}るく→明るい：00616_akarui⟧⟦なる→なる：01970_naru⟧。
examples.english: When spring comes, more people dress in lighter clothes and the town takes on a brighter atmosphere.

notes:
A compound of {薄|うす} (thin) and {着|ぎ} (wearing). The antonym is ⟦{厚着|あつぎ}→厚着：15266_atsugi⟧ (heavy clothing, dressing warmly).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {薄着|うすぎ}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{出|で}かける→出かける：00833_dekakeru⟧ (go out lightly dressed)
- {薄着|うすぎ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧ (dress lightly)
- {薄着|うすぎ}すぎる (be too lightly dressed)

Often used in the context of parents warning children to dress warmly, or in seasonal observations about clothing changes. In health discussions, {薄着|うすぎ} for children is sometimes recommended as a way to build resilience to cold ({薄着|うすぎ}{健康法|けんこうほう}).
